register.labelZh: TUCK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: tuck away 可以表示把物件安全收藏好,也可以形容遠離繁忙街道和人群的隱蔽地方。；tuck in 和 tuck into 可以表示某人開始津津有味地吃東西,特別適合描述肚餓時的情況。；tuck somebody in 和 tuck somebody up 可以描述在某人睡覺前替他/她蓋好被子。；TUCK 片語動詞可以表示把恤衫或鬆出的部分塞好,也可以表示把雙腳或膝蓋收近身體。
register.summaryEn: Tuck away can describe something stored safely or a place hidden from busy streets and crowds. Tuck in and tuck into can show that somebody starts eating eagerly, especially when they are hungry. Tuck somebody in and tuck somebody up describe covering someone comfortably with blankets before sleep. TUCK expressions can describe pushing a shirt or loose edge inside, as well as pulling your feet or knees close to your body.
